description.value:
Trigger A Signal-declared effect of yours fails

Traits Paradise-Touched

You immediately reattempt the triggering effect, declared Static, without spending Bandwidth and without spending actions. The reattempt is a fresh attempt in every respect: it is Static, so failing it costs nothing, and succeeding puts it under the GM's secret flat check as always. You have already taken the Signal failure's damage and Drift; this does not undo either.

cinderfall.incomplete: Free reaction: reattempt a failed Signal effect, declared Static, for free. This hands a new usable reattempt action (bucket 3) on top of waiving the Bandwidth cost of the reattempted effect. Per the task's own framing, always INCOMPLETE regardless of how clean the shape looks. The class's Signal/Static core mechanic has no rule-element analog anywhere in pf2e-source: `AdjustDegreeOfSuccess` evaluates in `beforePrepareData`, before the roll resolves, so it cannot hook a GM's own secret post-roll check or show the player a value other than what was actually computed (`pf2e-source/src/module/rules/rule-element/adjust-degree-of-success.ts`); self-inflicted reactive damage/resource cost keyed to the resolving effect's own degree of success has no rule-element home; and no `Reroll` rule-element key exists anywhere in the compendium (`pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/ancestry/human/level-1/courteous-comeback.json` ships `rules: []`). No `SpecialResource` rule element exists anywhere in the corpus for Bandwidth -- confirmed corpus-wide (`grep -rl "\"key\": \"SpecialResource\"" site/data/cards/` returns zero hits), and the class card itself (`site/data/cards/classes/classes.paradise-touched.json:49`) ships `system.rules: []`. Same absence class as Cultist Zeal/Ironsight Drift/Fleshmancer Vitae.
